verses.1: Praise the LORD, all nations; all peoples, give him praise.
verses.2: For his steadfast love is mighty over us, and the truth of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!

notes:
Notes
- v. 2: "gavar alaynu" is read as “is mighty over us,” reflecting the strength and sufficiency of God’s hesed (steadfast love).
